page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-lc2m1.nano is a shared burstable instance designed for minimal entry-level computing needs. It provides a single vCPU derived from a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor on the x86_64 architecture, managed by a KVM hypervisor. The CPU configuration contains one physical core operating a single thread with burstable CPU allocation. Hardware instruction support includes AVX, AVX-512F, AES cryptography extensions, FMA, and BMI2. The instance includes 0.5 GB of system memory, matching an allocation of 0.5 GB per core, with 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 33 MB shared L3 cache allocation.

Hardware bundling is minimal, featuring no integrated local disk storage and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Network baseline bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps, meaning all networking and storage traffic relies on shared virtualized interfaces without dedicated capacity guarantees. GPU acceleration is absent with zero GPUs configured.

Benchmark measurements reflect the constraints of its single burstable core and minimal memory allocation. Synthetic compute evaluation through stress-ng measures 1081.99 in both single-core and multi-core operations, ranking in the bottom 25 percent and bottom 10 percent of recorded instances respectively. PassMark CPU testing yields an overall score of 1288.11, with 1162.48 on extended instructions and 401.62 on encryption. Memory throughput within a cached 16 KB read block achieves 80.33 GB/sec. Application testing demonstrates 1.28 million Redis SET operations per second and 0.94 GB/sec throughput for static web serving.

Given its constrained memory footprint and shared CPU allocation, the instance presents low operational overhead for non-critical, lightweight services. The 0.5 GB RAM boundary limits complex runtimes, making the instance appropriate for simple utilities, low-traffic microservices, cron jobs, network testing endpoints, or basic development and learning environments.
